defaultContent.headline: Got questions?
defaultContent.subheadline: Quick answers to the things people ask most. Still curious? We are happy to chat.
defaultContent.contactLabel: Cannot find what you are looking for?

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: Most teams ship a polished site in a single day. The editor handles design and performance for you.

items.question: Can I use a custom domain?
items.answer: Yes — connect any domain and we will handle SSL automatically. You can also export to host elsewhere.

items.question: Do you support teams?
items.answer: Invite teammates, leave inline comments, and review changes before they ship — all in real time.

items.question: What about accessibility?
items.answer: Every section is built to WCAG 2.1 AA standards by default, so your site is accessible from day one.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Start free for 14 days, no credit card required. Cancel any time from your dashboard.

items.question: How do you handle data?
items.answer: We are SOC 2 Type II compliant, support SSO, and encrypt data at rest and in transit.
